title: Evaluation of the pilot project “Gesunde Pflege pflegt gesund” - A pilot project for the development, implementation and evaluation of a multimodal program incorporating traditional, complementary and integrative medicine approaches for workplace health promotion in long-term care facilities.
summary:
The project “Gesunde Pflege pflegt gesund” (GPPG) can be located in the area of workplace health promotion (WHP) and prevention It aims to develop, implement, and evaluate an evidence-based, multimodal WHP program grounded in traditional, complementary, and integrative medicine (TCIM) approaches, within the setting of longterm-care facilities. The project will be conducted at a single selected facility.
An explorative evaluation will accompany the project. The aim of the evaluation is to obtain information on the (subjective) effectiveness and feasibility of the program. The data will consist of questionnaires for the staff of the model facility on the topics of stress, sleep, job retention, pain, burnout, smoking and attitudes to healthy eating, as well as the amount of staff sick days. In addition, interviews are conducted with the staff to obtain in-depth information about their experiences with and opinions about the WHP program. Data collection via questionnaires will take place at three points in time: 1) before the workshops are held (planned for quartal 1, 2025); 2) after the workshops have been held (planned for quartal 3/4, 2025); 3) after the measures have been introduced (planned for quartal 3/4, 2025). The interviews will be conducted at survey point 3).
conditions: Not applicable - this is a project for workplace health promotion and prevention, no specific health problem is being investigated

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
The entire permanent staff of the facility (n = 33) will be requested for the quantitative data collection. Participation in the data collection is voluntary; signed consent is required.
Exclusion criteria:
no signed consent
